kitDescription: Mari is an Electric Supporter sniper whose value is team buffing rather than her own shot damage. Whenever she lands a shot on the boss's core, the whole team gains Pierce Damage +40.99% for 10 seconds, and her full-charge shots also grant a shield-damage buff that has no target on the current partless boss. Her second skill periodically grants herself Pierce and +30.78% ATK for 5 seconds, and gives every ally a flat attack grant equal to 30.78% of Mari's own ATK for 5 seconds. Her Burst II fires a single 639.36% nuke at the enemy and then buffs the whole team's Attack Damage by +40.99% for 10 seconds, covering the Full Burst window that follows her cast. Because her own Pierce grant tags her attacks, she personally benefits from the Pierce Damage buff she hands out.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas: all seven kit lines are FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP, and the two blind cross-family re-derivations converge with the driver on every load-bearing encoding (requiresCore pierceDamagePct in the Damage-Up bucket; timed gainPierce(5s) rather than whole-fight hasPierce; self atkPct vs ally casterAtkPct flat-add distinction; burst-cast nuke FB-exempt by timing; burst AD buff keyed to burstCast on cast frames, not fullBurstEnter). (a) The single S5 RED is ruled a FIXTURE ARTIFACT, not a REAL-GOTCHA: the assertion 'always-pierce strictly out-damages the shipped model' is false under any refresh cadence shorter than the 5s window, and the shipped ⚑ shotFired trigger refreshes every ~1.4s — byte-equality is the faithful outcome of continuous fire, while inspection (MR5: durationSec 5, no top-level hasPierce, empty unmodeled.skill2) proves the bounded encoding is what shipped. The S5 burst skips are likewise its own fixture defect (crown monopolizes the B2 slot); the driver's sole-B2 fixture exercises every burst line green. (b) The S2 trigger divergence is a kit-silent ⚑ on BOTH sides — the blind's interval:10 fabricates a cooldown constant absent from the prose, while the driver's shotFired keys to an observable, fabricates nothing, honors the stated 5s durations, and degrades correctly in downtime; the driver records estimate + measurement recipe (watch when the ally ATK icon refreshes in footage) + the cross-family interval alternative and its large uptime swing. Acceptable as documented; not a gotcha. (c) Every ⚑ (S2 trigger, cadence tuple, SR bolt-gap default, shield-damage out-of-domain) carries estimate + recipe + tier, and the shield line sits verbatim in unmodeled. Residual same-model risk the owner should spot-check: all agents share the prior that a no-activation-clause skill is a repeating trigger and that pierceDamagePct is live for pierce-tagged hits (schema-comment ambiguity S2b flagged) — the trigger identity is the one claim no artifact in the packet independently settles; one Mari-focus video resolves it and the bolt-gap question together.
